name: The Monogrammed Sash
summary: A fine sash bearing embroidered initials hints at a rightful owner somewhere in Stranglethorn Vale. Finding the seafarer who lost it leads on to The Captain's Cutlass.

sections.title: A Marked Garment
sections.body: This fine sash bears the letters 'HS' embroidered along its hem. Whoever lost it can only be traced by those two letters.

sections.title: The Smotts Connection
sections.body: Returning the garment to Captain Hecklebury Smotts confirms it belongs to him. Recovering it reveals that the sea giant Mok'rash has been slain, bringing relief to the captain after the brute took part in destroying his vessels and crew on multiple occasions.

faq.q: What letters are stitched into the sash?
faq.answer: The hem of the fine sash is embroidered with the initials 'HS'.

aliases: what quest comes after monogrammed sash
faq.answer: Once the sash is returned to its owner, the next step is The Captain's Cutlass.
